decidedBy: the project owner, 2026-10-12: where the text says a father begat a nation, the begotten one is read as a son and shown as the people descended from him; each word read against its verse by claude-opus-5-5
policy: In the tables of nations (Genesis 10 and 1 Chronicles 1) a name the text lists among the sons a father begat is the son, named as the verse names him, whatever form the name has. The people of the same name is a record of its own, descended from him, and keeps every other word that names it.
source: Essenthos, on the project owner's ruling of 2026-10-12 that the nations a father begat in the tables of nations are his sons and the peoples descended from them, each word read against its verse by claude-opus-5-5

rulings.why: 'Canaan begat Sidon his firstborn, and Heth, and the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgasite (10:15-16)': the text names the Jebusite among the sons Canaan begat, so the word is the son, and the people descended from him keep their own record.
The list of Canaan's sons again, as GEN 10:16 gives it: the word is the son, and the people descended from him keep their own record.
